en-US.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
en-US.description: Notes, documents and tasks, all local. No subscription, no telemetry.
en-US.longDescription:
Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
en-US.name: Tisty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Tisty 1.45.0
Your parcels go out signed, and the sidebar gives its room to your tasks or your documents
- Once you have your identity, what you export for Tisty goes out signed with your key: another Tisty of yours takes it as yours, and anyone else sees your name and your fingerprint.
- A parcel changed on the way comes in as a stranger's.
- Someone else's locked parcel no longer comes in as yours just because you know its six digits.
- A document you shared through Folio carries who edited it when you export it.
- The sidebar puts your tasks on top, with search, the date and the day's counts, and overdue and late open a view of their own.
- You give the sidebar's room to your tasks or to your library, and the other stays in sight.
- The first lists are born with a colour of their own.
- The help and the guide follow the new sidebar.
What's Changed
- ci: a pull request's run created after its merge waits in its own group and never cancels main's run by @rgdevment in #677
- feat(parcel): a .tistyx is signed by its owner, and whose it is on import rests on that signature by @rgdevment in #678
- feat(parcel): a signed .tistyx carries who edited each shared document, shown as its signer tells it by @rgdevment in #679
- feat(ui): the sidebar gives its room to tasks or to the library by @rgdevment in #680
- docs: a .tistyx is told as signed by its owner, with who edited it, in the help, README, PRIVACY and SECURITY by @rgdevment in #681
- docs: a parcel's texts name the computer key, ask only a store with no person, and say what the seal spares by @rgdevment in #682
- docs: the 1.45.0 news, and the help, guide, README and LEEME follow the new sidebar by @rgdevment in #683
Full Changelog: v1.44.1...v1.45.0

es.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
es.description: Notas, documentos y tareas, todo local. Sin suscripción ni telemetría.
es.longDescription:
Tisty guarda lo que sabes en tu propio equipo: notas, documentos y tareas, en archivos
Markdown que puedes leer sin él. Todo lo que haces se escribe en un registro que solo
crece, así que nada se pierde por accidente y un cambio se puede deshacer; borrar para
siempre es el único paso que no. Sin cuenta, sin
suscripción, sin telemetría y sin servidor. La sincronización, si la quieres, pasa por
una carpeta que tus equipos ya alcanzan, y un asistente entra por una puerta que abres tú.
es.name: Tisty
